No fitting adequacy or human predictive validity is established.

findings.reason: F0003:S1:T17:A242 and A246 establish digitized means without recovered SD or individual IDs. Caption n>=3 and methods n=4/time are different reported count descriptions; neither establishes the exact count contributing to each marker. Marker labels are not animal identifiers, and terminal sampling does not establish serial animal trajectories.
findings.needed_material: Confirm marker-specific sample counts and the relationship between caption and methods descriptions during coverage review. Retain unrecovered SD and individual identities as unknown; do not substitute pixel tolerance for biological variability.

findings.reason: F0003:S1:T17:A241 and A245 identify IT ELF observations and mg BASE/kg dosing. ELF total versus unbound concentration basis and formulation are NOT_FOUND. The plasma-total note in A247 and plasma fu in A248 do not define the ELF concentration basis.
findings.needed_material: Source-backed ELF concentration-basis and formulation definitions before any dependent comparison or conversion; preserve these fields as unknown until resolved.

findings.reason: The item supplies one mouse IT dose-level ELF mean curve with nominal times from 0.25 to 12 h and terminal sampling. Actual collection times, body weights, recovered biological variability and animal-level records are NOT_FOUND. Pixel-derived times are approximate extraction coordinates, not verified actual collection times. This page does not establish model input sufficiency.
findings.needed_material: Downstream assessment of these group-level inputs against the stated animal PK objective, with any necessary sampling, administration and animal-characteristic clarification. Keep model-dependent adequacy DEFERRED to animal PK work.

findings.reason: The source establishes mouse pulmonary input identity but does not specify requested model curves or parameters, intended downstream use or a design-supported held-out prediction opportunity. It supplies no basis for deciding rat, rabbit or systemic coverage.
